name: @pipeworx/mcp-jikan

tools.name: search_anime
tools.description: Search for anime by title. Returns title, score, type, episode count, status, synopsis, and genres.

query.description: Anime title to search for (e.g., "Fullmetal Alchemist")

tools.name: get_anime
tools.description: Get full details for an anime by ID. Returns score, synopsis, genres, studios, episode count, and more.

id.description: MyAnimeList anime ID (e.g., 5114 for Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood)

tools.name: top_anime
tools.description: Get top-ranked anime, optionally filtered by type (e.g., "tv", "movie", "ova", "ona"). Returns titles, scores, and rankings.

type.description: Filter by anime type: tv, movie, ova, special, ona, music. Omit for all types.

tools.name: search_characters
tools.description: Search for anime/manga characters by name. Returns character names, nicknames, favorites count, and biography.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jikan forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jikan pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
